title: Morse Topology, Zero Products, and Elliptic Prime Crossings
summary: We study how the noncentral zeros of an elliptic-curve $L$-function enter the Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer (BSD) leading coefficient and the prime-scale crossings of an elliptic Chebyshev race. Under the elliptic-curve Riemann hypothesis (ECRH), the completed $L$-function yields an exact Hadamard decomposition, and the zero statistics $J_E$ and $V_E$ satisfy the positive identity $J_E=V_E/8+Δ_E$.
